scope: Terra review of the two remaining Kanto TERRA targets only. Existing production sources and generated artifacts were not changed.

outcomes.name: ミューザ川崎シンフォニーホール
outcomes.firstPass: The official 2023 numbered map was rendered and read at full resolution. Its printed table gives 1,987 numbered general seats plus 10 separately identified wheelchair positions, totaling 1,997.
outcomes.independentSecondPass: The current official seat page was independently checked against the same issuer PDF. The page exposes seat-view anchors but no row/number inventory that can independently reproduce range endpoints.
outcomes.differenceCheck: The total-position evidence matches (1,997); a zero-diff range comparison is unavailable because no issuer-published row/number inventory exists. Block-total fitting was rejected.
outcomes.reason: Do not manufacture row ranges or wheelchair seat numbers from aggregate block totals.

outcomes.name: 所沢市民文化センター ミューズ アークホール
outcomes.firstPass: The official A3 numbered map was rendered and read at full resolution. It labels a maximum 2,002-seat pattern and PA/wheelchair locations.
outcomes.independentSecondPass: The official facility page independently states 2,002 seats (1F 1,106; 2F 560; 3F 336) and that 13 first-floor movable seats can convert to six wheelchair positions.
outcomes.differenceCheck: The floor totals match the maximum-use map. The sources do not establish one fixed representative selectable configuration across the movable-seat and wheelchair-conversion states.
outcomes.reason: Do not select a normal or converted configuration by inference.

summary.nextQueue: Sol high Kanto P0 macro only; do not begin Tokyo top-up or national-city work.
